original_test_intent: Verify four DIMM-zone thermal resources consistently across IB/OOB SDR, IB/OOB Sensor List and BMC Web, with names, descriptions, readings, units and states bound to the approved zone-to-slot topology and aggregation SPEC.
original_method: Prove common target identity; record memory population; collect complete unfiltered command views and all four Web rows inside a bounded interval; map each zone to CPU/channel/slot members and aggregation semantics; normalize fields and compare to SPEC without clearing logs or mutating thermal state.
manual_activity: A platform reviewer approves zone membership/aggregation and visually confirms four Web rows plus their five-view SPEC comparison.
safety_requirements: Do not change thresholds, fans, power or configuration
Capture full lists and Web context
Do not infer zone membership from order
Reject missing, duplicate or stale views
agent_execution_scope: Collect full IB/OOB SDR and Sensor lists
Capture all four protected Web rows
Map zones to populated slots and aggregation rules
Normalize identity, description, value, units, state, thresholds and timestamps
engineer_actions: Approve zone membership, aggregation and SPEC
Resolve missing, swapped or divergent zones

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: A literal `TEMP_DIMM_Zone1~4` sensor-get does not enumerate four zones; one OOB read and first 100 SDR lines cannot meet five-view or topology coverage.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Collect complete IB/OOB lists and four explicit Web resources, then key the normalized comparison by approved zone membership rather than display order.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All five views and four zones remain; source timing is retained as metadata while grep-only, truncation and log clearing are excluded.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Build a four-zone matrix listing member DIMM slots, population, aggregation rule and each of five timestamped representations.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds zone semantics, population-aware completeness and time-bounded field normalization.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Four plausible temperatures can still be mislabeled or calculated from the wrong slots/channels.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A zone proxy or maximum may legitimately differ from individual DIMM sensors; only the platform aggregation definition controls acceptance.

project_override_considerations: Define every zone's member slots, treatment of unpopulated locations, aggregation method, canonical fields, ranges and cross-view tolerance. Private Script use requires a pinned review.
expected_evidence: Memory population plus zone-to-slot/aggregation matrix and SPEC
Complete decoded IB/OOB SDR and Sensor lists
Four complete Web rows with page context
Redaction, no-mutation/no-clear audit and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, procedure and criteria consistently require four DIMM zones across five views. Generic clear and DeepSeek's incomplete literal-range command are method defects.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Zone topology, aggregation, parsers, access and SPEC are identifiable package inputs; mark execution BLOCKED only if zone semantics remain unresolved after obtaining them.

review_improvement: Prevents one literal query or individual-DIMM data from standing in for four topology-defined aggregated zones.
independent_technical_reasoning: Memory thermal zones are platform abstractions whose membership can cross channels or use a hottest-member proxy. Without the zone-to-slot and aggregation definition, correct-looking values cannot prove coverage; population-aware mapping is required before cross-interface equality has meaning.
